name: research-dev-orchestrator
description: Safe, evidence-backed orchestration for research, software delivery, and job-search work.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, parallelize, verify, and safely integrate complex work.
interface.longDescription: Provides reusable Codex workflows for multi-agent research, machine-learning experiments, web and app delivery, and job-search support. It records evidence, separates execution from verification, and stops for approval before external side effects.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the appropriate Research Dev Orchestrator workflow to plan and execute this request with evidence, review gates, and approval boundaries.
